```yaml
name: Devin Session on Label
on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]
jobs:
  create-devin-session:
    if: github.event.label.name == 'devin'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Get issue metadata
        id: get_issue
        run: |
          echo "issue_title=$(jq -r '.issue.title' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "issue_url=$(jq -r '.issue.html_url' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "issue_body=$(jq -r '.issue.body' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Devin session
        id: create_session
        run: |
          TITLE="${{ env.issue_title }}"
          URL="${{ env.issue_url }}"
          BODY="${{ env.issue_body }}"
          
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.devin.ai/v1/sessions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"prompt\": \"Issue: $TITLE\\nURL: $URL\\nDescription: $BODY\", \"idempotent\": true}")
          
          SESSION_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.session_id')
          SESSION_URL="https://app.devin.ai/session/$SESSION_ID"
          echo "SESSION_URL=$SESSION_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Comment on issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const sessionUrl = process.env.SESSION_URL;
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.payload.issue.number,
              body: `Devin session created: ${sessionUrl}`
            });
```
